category_title: High school student with AD/HD exhibiting inattention, hyperactivity, and impulsivity
scenario_title: ICT biology lesson with interactive whiteboard and worksheets
minimal_context: Marios is working with his group to complete a worksheet after using the PhET Natural Selection software on the interactive whiteboard.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Marios, now that we've used the PhET Natural Selection software on the interactive whiteboard, please work with your group to complete the worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It was clear how it changed according to the conditions, how they grew . . . the population was decreasing . . . etc. . . . the class with the use of the interactive whiteboard is more pleasant.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I'm glad you found it pleasant. Now, please write down your observations on the worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, nothing in specific impressed me. It was because it was done in a different way . . . it was more interesting. But . . .we will see examples on the interactive whiteboard . . . but we could also follow the traditional way of teaching.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That's an interesting thought. For now, please finish answering the questions on your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I helped the group with the first part, but I'm leaving the rest of these questions unanswered. I don't want to complete the rest of the worksheet.
